q: What exactly is this kit, and what do I get when I clone it?
a: This kit is a production-ready NoSQL backend and analytics platform combining Laravel 12 with official MongoDB 7+ support. You get a pre-wired Docker Compose container setup, 6 AI agent rule dialects, 5 operational skills, automated security tests, and an EventLog document analytics starter.

q: Which versions does it pin, and why those?
a: It pins PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12, mongodb/laravel-mongodb 5.0, and MongoDB 7.0+. These versions provide native BSON type support, aggregation pipeline builders, WiredTiger document engine optimization, and long-term security support.

q: Which AI coding agents are supported, and how do the rules reach each one?
a: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cline, and Antigravity are supported via transpiled native dialect targets generated from canonical source rules.

q: What do I need installed before I start?
a: You only need Docker Engine 24+ and Docker Compose v2.20+. All runtime dependencies (PHP 8.4 with ext-mongodb, MongoDB 7.0, Redis 7, Composer) run inside isolated containers.

q: How long does installation take, honestly, and what can slow it down?
a: A fresh install takes between 60 to 90 seconds on a standard broadband connection. Primary bottleneck is compiling the PHP MongoDB PECL driver and pulling base container images.

q: Is the starter production-shaped or a demo? What must I change before real production?
a: The starter is production-shaped with strict security defaults. Before production release, configure authentication on MongoDB with a dedicated app user, set APP_DEBUG=false, and enable TLS for database traffic.

q: How is security handled in this kit, and where are its checks?
a: Security is enforced at multiple layers: NoSQL operator injection sanitization, BSON ObjectId format validation, BOLA document policies, and automated secret scanning. The complete 12-control suite is in security/checks.json.

q: Can I change the design? Where do the design tokens live?
a: Yes. Design tokens are documented in DESIGN.md. Frontend layouts use Tailwind CSS utility tokens and responsive cards.

q: How do I update when a new kit version releases?
a: Review CHANGELOG.md and merge updates to rules/ and skills/. Project-specific document models, controllers, and .env settings remain untouched.

q: Can I use it for commercial and client work?
a: Yes. The entire kit is licensed under the permissive MIT License with zero royalties.

q: How do I contribute a fix or a skill back?
a: Submit a PR to https://github.com/Umar-444/Techtalks-stack-kits adhering to the 18-checkpoint completeness standard.

q: Where do I get help or report a problem?
a: Open an issue on the repository or participate in community discussions at https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com.

q: Why does this kit use MongoDB instead of a relational database?
a: MongoDB is ideal for unstructured payloads, flexible event logs, hierarchical telemetry data, and high-frequency writes that do not require rigid tabular schemas.

q: Why are there no relational migrations, and how does data modeling work here?
a: MongoDB is schema-flexible. Document structure is governed at the application layer by Eloquent models and embedded document schemas. Migrations are used exclusively for defining compound indexes and collection validation rules.
